description: ExtractionOutput: see $defs/ExtractionOutput. What the extraction LLM returns (M1-06): candidate facts, each with the patient's words copied verbatim. Code finds every quote in the transcript and computes the offsets itself; a fact it cannot verify is dropped, never stored. Research prototype; synthetic data only.

ExtractedFact.description: One candidate fact. Only StructuredFacts keys are allowed (FactKey), so the model cannot invent fields.

value.description: yes/no answers as true/false or "yes"/"no"/"unknown"; numbers as numbers; free text as a string.

unit.description: The unit the patient used, if any (e.g. "C", "/10").

turn_id.description: The patient turn the quote comes from.

quote.description: The patient's words, copied verbatim from that turn.

char_start.description: The model's offset. Ignored: code recomputes it from the quote.

char_end.description: The model's offset. Ignored: code recomputes it from the quote.

negated.description: True when the patient denied it ("no chest pain").
